question: The outer-most range of the Himalayas is called the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Shiwaliks.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Outer Himalayas are called Siwalik or Shiwalik.
 
• They are the sub-Himalayan range of the northern Indian subcontinent.
 
• It expands west-northwestward from the Tisza River in Sikkim state through Nepal, across northwestern India, and into northern Pakistan.
 
• Composed of loose sediments and the valleys are usually coated with heavy gravel and alluvium.
 
• The width of the Shivalik Hills ranges from about 10 to 50km, their average height is around 1500-2000 m. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• DIVISION OF HIMALAYAS

 
 
• Shiwalik or the outer Himalayas
 
• Lesser or Middle Himalayas
 
• The Greater Himalayas
 
• The Trans-Himalayas – Tibetan Himalayas.
 
• The Eastern Hills – Purvanchal: A chain of hills in North-East India.
